en.q: Radioactive material 'A' has decay constant '8λ' and material 'B' has decay constant 'λ'. Initially they have same number of nuclei. After what time, the ratio of number of nuclei of material 'B' to that 'A' will be 1/e?

review.keyCheck: Official CBSE key, NEET 2017 Code A: 2
review.keySource: Published answer key, NEET 2017 Code A (neet-sources/neet-papers/2017/answer-key-code-A.pdf); text from the Aakash Code A solutions (neet-sources/neet-papers/2017/solutions-code-A.pdf; read from page images)
review.note: As printed, N<sub>B</sub>/N<sub>A</sub> = e<sup>7λt</sup> only grows; the key's 1/(7λ) corresponds to N<sub>A</sub>/N<sub>B</sub> = 1/e.

en.q:
Four statements are given (A is mass number) :
A. The volume of a nucleus is proportional to A1/3.
B. The volume of a nucleus is proportional to A.
C. The difference in mass of an atom and its nucleus is called the mass defect.
D. The difference in mass of a nucleus and its constituents is called the mass defect.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
o: A and D are true, but B and C are false
B and D are true, but A and C are false
B and C are true, but A and D are false
A and C are true, but B and D are false
